Patient past history revealed a thyroidectomy that was performed after a third relapse of GD. Hyperthyroidism started fifteen years ago. At that time, thyroid stimulating immunoglobulin (TSI) was positive. Our assessment showed that autoimmune Abs including TSI, anti-gastric parietal cell, anti-intrinsic factor, anti-21-hydroxylase, anti-transglutaminase, and anti-gliadin Abs were all negative. Only the anti-thyroid peroxidase (TPO) and anti-thyroglobulin Abs were strongly positive at 45. 2 UI/mL (normal < 5. 6 ) and 21. 1 UI/mL (normal < 4. 1 ), respectively.
